entry.name: plugout~
entry.digest: Define a Max for Live Device's audio outputs
entry.description: The plugout~ object sends its output to the Live application as part of a Max for Live Audio device or Instrument.

arguments.name: output-channel-destination
arguments.description: Although theobject will accept one or two int arguments as a courtesy to Max 4 users who wish to port older plug-ins, output channel specifications are disabled. This behavior is modified when Max for Live is in.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Send audio to Max for Live
messages.description: By convention, a Max for Live gets all its audio from the Live application using theobject and sends its audio output using theobject. This audio output is limited to two channels.

inlets.digest: (signal) Channel 1 audio from a Max patch in a Max for Live Audio device or Instrument to be sent to the Live application
(signal) Channel 2 audio from a Max patch in a Max for Live Audio device or Instrument to be sent to the Live application

outlets.digest: (signal) Test output to pass thru for audio device channel 1.
(signal) Test output to pass thru for audio device channel 2.
